journey.title: Unrecognized or blank countries must not save an old code
journey.goal: Saving must submit exactly what each country field shows. A listed country submits its code. An empty, blank or unrecognized entry submits no saved country (an empty value). Keyboard and pointer selection of listed countries must keep working.
